scientific_integrity: Analytical derivation supplies the theorem, exact rational example checked symbolically; small-grid and orbit simulations are illustrative. Broad originality remains subject to independent literature verification.
scientific_limitations: Only the hyperbolic all-defector logistic resource period-two orbit in the stated positive-payoff map; local transverse stability, not global ecological fate, chaotic attractors, or threshold equality.
title: Exact two-cycle invasion threshold and the failure of mean-game prediction in a harvested-resource evolutionary game
